schema.title: A reader's prediction

rules.city_limits: a party's share of the ward ballot lies in city_limits[party]
rules.conflict: where the map needs more (or less) of the vote than the citywide limit allows, the map wins
rules.fallback: a painted ward whose ranges no share vector satisfies uses the shape alone: winner at least q_win, every other party at most q_run
rules.scope: the editor only: an entry outside these bounds is valid and opens with a note
rules.shape: in a painted ward the winner holds at least q_win of the ward's vote and every other party at most q_run; a party's list share minus its ward share, in points, is between gap_min and gap_max
rules.ward_ranges: a party's share of a ward's vote lies in ward_ranges[ward][party], or, where that is absent, in party_ranges[party]; together with the shape, the least and greatest each party can hold in each ward, weighted by e, bound its ward vote
